name: @pet-oasis/api
description: API REST de um pet shop online — autenticação, autorização RBAC e gestão de usuários construídas do zero, com TDD.
author: Rafael Maia da Fonseca

scripts.dev: HOST_UID=$(id -u) HOST_GID=$(id -g) docker compose -p pet-oasis-dev --env-file .env.development -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up --build --remove-orphans
scripts.dev:down: docker compose -p pet-oasis-dev --env-file .env.development -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose -p pet-oasis-dev --env-file .env.development -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml down -v --remove-orphans && pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:mail: docker compose -p pet-oasis-dev --env-file .env.development -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up -d mailpit
scripts.dev:db: docker compose -p pet-oasis-dev --env-file .env.development -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.dev.yml up --wait -d db
scripts.prod:up: docker compose -p pet-oasis-prod --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml up --build --wait -d --remove-orphans
scripts.prod:down: docker compose -p pet-oasis-prod --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml down --remove-orphans
scripts.prod:logs: docker compose -p pet-oasis-prod --env-file .env.production -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.prod.yml logs -f
scripts.test: bash -c 'trap "pnpm run test:services:down" EXIT; pnpm run test:services:up && vitest run'
scripts.test:coverage: bash -c 'trap "pnpm run test:services:down" EXIT; pnpm run test:services:up && vitest run --coverage'
scripts.test:watch: bash -c 'trap "pnpm run test:services:down" EXIT; pnpm run test:services:up && vitest'
scripts.test:services:up: docker compose -p pet-oasis-test --env-file .env.test -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.test.yml up --wait -d db redis
scripts.test:services:down: docker compose -p pet-oasis-test --env-file .env.test -f infra/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker-compose.test.yml down -v
